results.headline: R.E.A. Holdings plc: Half yearly results
results.key_quote: H1 was a period of solid operational performance, delivering growth in profitability due to firm, sustained pricing of palm products. We successfully navigated some challenges resulting from market uncertainty around the export of Indonesian palm products.
results.summary: REA reported half-year results with increased profitability and EBITDA despite CPO export regulation uncertainties. Revenue of $88.6m (2025: $92.4m) reflected customer delivery delays now being caught up. EBITDA increased to $35.2m (2025: $33.4m) and operating profit rose to $23.3m (2025: $19.2m). The company describes performance as 'solid operational performance' and 'growth in profitability' but does not explicitly state results are ahead of, above, or exceeding market or analyst expectations. Management commentary indicates navigation of challenges and stabilisation rather than outperformance of forecasts.

results.headline: Hussar EP513 Prospect Update
results.key_quote: Georgina's contractors have done an excellent job of preparing the site and access roads to enable the mobilisation of the Ensign 970 drill rig to enable the drill testing of this exciting prospect, however, unexpected heavy rainfall and road closures have caused the targeted drill program to be delayed
results.summary: Georgina Energy announced completion of pre-drill site preparation and civil engineering works for the Hussar EP513 prospect, with all major infrastructure completed including drilling pad, water well, conductor pipe, and airstrip. However, unseasonable record-breaking rainfall and resulting road closures in Western Australia have delayed the planned September mobilisation of the Ensign 970 drill rig. The company stated it is hopeful of mobilising the rig subject to safety constraints and weather/road conditions. No performance metrics or expectations comparisons are provided; this is a project update announcement with no guidance on financial or operational performance versus prior expectations.
